links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and Reading Ease) of chatbot HPV vaccine responses
links.effect: Mean FKGL: ChatGPT 10.7, Claude 13.2, DeepSeek 11.3, Docus 12.2; Reading Ease means 32.5-46.8. Some responses included medical jargon.
links.quote: Improvements in readability, personalization, and link accuracy are still needed.

links.outcome: Whether chatbots defer complex questions to health care professionals
links.effect: All 4 chatbots appropriately deferred complex questions to health care professionals' suggestions.
links.quote: For complex questions, all AI chatbots appropriately deferred to health care professionals' suggestions.

links.outcome: Accuracy and validity of sources and citations in chatbot responses
links.effect: All chatbots cited reputable sources with no fabricated information, but some responses included broken or irrelevant links.
links.quote: Occasionally, some responses included broken or irrelevant links and medical jargon.

screen.reason: Empirical content analysis evaluating commercial LLM chatbots on simulated HPV vaccine questions; it assesses baseline model capabilities without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
